title: Runtime Compatibility & Serverless Guarantees
philosophy: Pure JavaScript OpenXML parsing with zero native binary dependencies (no Microsoft Office, no LibreOffice, no Java VM, no Electron, no node-gyp).

runtimes.name: Node.js (>= 18, 20.x, 22.x, 24.x)
runtimes.notes: Full support for CJS (require) and ESM (import) with native TypeScript definitions (.d.ts). High-performance in-memory Virtual File System.

runtimes.name: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18 / 20 / 22)
runtimes.notes: Instant cold-start execution without disk writes. Export directly via ppt.toBuffer() or stream to S3 buckets.

runtimes.name: Cloudflare Workers (V8 Isolates)
runtimes.notes: Zero Node.js fs dependencies. Ingest from web streams or ArrayBuffer, export via ppt.toArrayBuffer() directly to HTTP responses.

runtimes.name: Vercel Edge & Serverless Functions
runtimes.notes: Compatible with Next.js App Router route handlers (app/api/generate/route.js). Zero temporary file disk pollution.

runtimes.name: Bun (>= 1.0)
runtimes.notes: High-throughput execution leveraging Bun fast ZIP and Buffer APIs.

guarantees.title: Zero Office / Electron Daemon
guarantees.description: Unlike unoconv, LibreOffice, or Puppeteer, node-pptx-templater does not launch background daemons or require 500MB+ Docker containers.

guarantees.title: In-Memory Virtual File System
guarantees.description: Operates 100% in RAM via Map<string, Uint8Array>. Eliminates /tmp write contention, disk IOPS costs, and concurrency race conditions.

guarantees.title: XXE & Security Guardrails
guarantees.description: Built-in protection against XML External Entity (XXE) and Billion Laughs exponential entity expansion attacks via strict parser configuration.

guarantees.title: Office Repair Warning Prevention
guarantees.description: Synchronous DrawingML and embedded Excel workbook cache updating guarantees slides open cleanly without Microsoft PowerPoint repair prompts.
